source.author: ov
source.text: Prima Melanchaetes in tergo vulnera fecit, proxima Therodamas, Oresitrophus haesit in armo: tardius exierant, sed per compendia montis anticipata via est.
source.text_original: Prima Melanchaetes in tergo vulnera fecit, / proxima Therodamas, Oresitrophus haesit in armo: / tardius exierant, sed per compendia montis / anticipata via est.
source.text_english: Melanchaetes dealt the first wounds on its back, Therodamas the next, Oresitrophus stuck in its shoulder: they had come out more slowly, but by shortcuts across the mountain the way was taken ahead of them.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_original: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis / ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum / horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_english: Look, by the steep shortcuts of the slanting mountain, the leader, eager and glad at the stratagem, recognizes Acastus, bristling with spears and flashing with the sheen of his round shield.
